author: SA For FAs
title: What Regulation Does Apple's CEO Fear? (Podcast) - Apple Inc. (NASDAQ:AAPL)
text:
Apple CEO Tim Cook is calling new tech regulations “inevitable.” He wasn’t too specific, but it seems he had in mind the European Union’s new GDPR regs, which raise the privacy of user data to a much higher level. The impact of these new regulations is not easy to calculate – it ultimately depends on which rules are enforced, which violations are fined, and by how much. Still, this brief podcast ( 4:14 ) argues that Cook is correct that regulation will likely increase, and that it may well be that the easy money has already been made in Big Data.
